evidence: The NHD-510-TX is a powerhouse in AV over IP technology, integrating HDMI and USB-C inputs for unparalleled connectivity with both traditional and modern digital devices. Enhanced with Dante AV-A support for superior audio over IP, HDMI loop-out for local display connectivity, and advanced audio switching capabilities, it stands as an essential component for any high-definition setup. As a 1 Gigabit solution, it confidently supports 4K60 4:4:4 video resolution, ensuring crystal-clear image quality across all applications. Whether upgrading commercial spaces, educational institutions, or secure government facilities, the NHD-510-TX delivers an immersive audiovisual experience with HDR10 and Dolby Vision support, minimal latency, and the ability to connect up to 7 USB devices simultaneously. This device is designed to meet the rigorous demands of any complex installation, offering a versatile, high-performance solution for contemporary AV challenges.

The NHD-510-TX revolutionizes input management with intelligent HDMI and USB-C ports that automatically switch between sources, ensuring seamless transitions during presentations or collaborative sessions. This auto-switch feature simplifies the user experience by automatically selecting the active input, making it effortless to manage multiple devices in dynamic AV environments.
Capable of encoding full HDMI 2.0 content. This includes 4K60 4:4:4 8bit and high dynamic range video including Dolby Vision, HDR10 & HLG up to 12bit 4:2:2 at 60Hz
